incidents.title: Allied Media / Allied Press: Confirmed cyberattack
incidents.description: Confirmed by the organisation, a regulator or a securities filing. First reported 24 Nov 2026. Allied Media / Allied Press experienced a cyberattack that disrupted production systems and delayed the distribution of several regional newspapers. The incident was disclosed on November 24. Dunedin, New Zealand.

incidents.description: ByteToBreach claimed it on a ransomware leak site on 24 Nov 2026. Not confirmed by the organisation, so treat it as a claim, not a fact. Hackers identified as ByteToBreach claimed to have stolen about 740 GB of data from Kenya’s eCitizen platform. The Kenyan government and the platform have not confirmed the breach. Kenya.
